description: Move a pinned vendored dependency from v1 to v2 and migrate the call site to the new API. Offline by construction — no registry, no network (ADR-019, §17).
prompt: This project pins a vendored dependency in deps.json. Bump text-util from 1.0.0 to 2.0.0: set the pinned version in deps.json to "2.0.0", make src/app.js require ./vendor/text-util/v2.js instead of v1, and migrate to v2's API — v1 exported `leftPad(text, width)`, v2 exports `pad(text, width, fill)` where `fill` defaults to a space. Give `formatRow` an optional third parameter `fill` that it forwards to `pad`. Two-argument calls to `formatRow` must behave exactly as they do today, and the existing tests must keep passing.
